detail.longDescription: Vite's "hidden" sourcemap option still writes .js.map files; it only drops the comment pointing to them. Deploy dist/ as-is and the maps are public. Check: add .map to a script URL and curl -sI it. 200 means your original code (sourcesContent) is readable. Fix: sourcemap: false, or upload maps to your error tool and delete them before deploy.
